title: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi chỗ nào mát hơn được không?
pronunciation: Chung toi co the ngoi cho nao mat hon duoc khong
summary: For asking to move toward shade, a fan, or air-conditioning when the heat is starting to matter.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask before ordering, waiting, or unpacking bags if the current seat is too hot to stay comfortable.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Gesture toward the cooler table, fan, shade, or indoor area. Keep the request light so staff can offer a practical alternative.

phrases.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi chỗ nào mát hơn được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Chung toi co the ngoi cho nao mat hon duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Chúng tôi có thể asks can we; ngồi chỗ nào means sit somewhere; mát hơn means cooler; được không asks is that possible.

breakdown.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi chỗ nào mát hơn được không?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Sit-by-the-fan, can-I-sit-here, and seats-together cards keep the seating request close.

phrases.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi cạnh quạt được không?
phrases.english: Can we sit by the fan?
phrases.pronunciation: Chung toi co the ngoi canh quat duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể ngồi đây được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the ngoi day duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi cùng nhau được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Chung toi co the ngoi cung nhau duoc khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good in cafes, food courts, hotel lobbies, tour stops, waiting rooms, and open-air restaurants during hot hours.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: A small move may solve it: one table nearer a fan, away from sun, or inside for a few minutes.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Sit-inside, sit-outside, air-conditioning, table, and seat-available cards cover the next comfort move.
